title: Complete-state killed excursions admit conditional acquisition and an ordinary comparator tie
statement: For complete prepared boundary states S and permanent absorbing product/degradation,the first return/arrival kernel K and success g give u=g+Ku=(I-K)^-1g when rho(K)<1. With independent Exp(mu) death,this is E[e^-mu tau_B 1_(tau_B<infinity)],not a deterministic-deadline distribution. Actual gateway microstate preparation,complete support and action-invariant hidden return kernels must be supplied/paid. Simultaneous gateway Clopper–Pearson intervals yield one confidence event for all candidate boundary-rate interventions;lower/upper inverses and conservative design selection apply equally to a conventional implementation. Same-support stochastic row perturbations bounded by m_i,M_i yield once-per-row eventual-success ratio between product(m_i/M_i) and product(M_i/m_i),including every success/death route and actual absorption. It is a different interface from N1596 all-deadline visible-prefix work,whose missing original archive/review remains unacquired. Synthetic40-stage/80-state example uses800000gateway assays and844245.882model-time units excluding preparation;true yield~3.12527e-12 is matched by the same-information O(N) conventional recurrence. Searching780two-rate-doubling actions on the same99%event chooses[34,35],true gain~2.02566 and conservative ratio>=.5765 in this fixture,not a general superiority result. Unknown shortcut1e-7 gives~24925-fold change;complete support is essential. Doob conditional skeleton sampling requires u already known and produces no cost-free physical success.

requires: Killed excursions need complete prepared boundary/gateway microstates,all failure routes,unchanged hidden excursions under admitted boundary actions,and rho(K)<1. Permanent exponential degradation gives a Laplace-discounted success interface,not a deterministic deadline CDF.

Task theorem needs exactly two distinct persistent propensities in[0,1],positive weights,fresh independent specimens,conditional stage independence and stable action responses;the alternate arbitrary-mode theorem needs a qualified monotone contrast.

Exact three-mode aliases/rare contamination defeat generalization. No novelty,superiority,device,wet-lab or operational chemistry claim;previous held transfers remain excluded.
